name: boxscore
description: Weekly box score summary for a multifamily property. One row per unit type from the Availability table, plus a few values that apply to the whole document. Ignore any Totals row.

property_name.name: Property Name
property_name.original: Property name from the top of the document, below the 'Box Score' heading. Exclude any text in parentheses. Same for every row.
property_name.description: Extract the property name from the top of the document, below the 'Box Score' heading. Exclude any text in parentheses. This value is the same for every row.

date.name: Report Date
date.original: The end date of the reporting period shown near the top as a date range. Take the second date of the range, in YYYY-MM-DD. Same for every row.
date.description: From the date range shown near the top, extract the second date, which is the reporting period end date. Return it in YYYY-MM-DD format. This value is the same for every row.

code.name: Code
code.original: Unit type code from the 'Code' column of the Availability table, e.g. PR - P1. One per row.
code.description: Extract the unit type code from the 'Code' column of the Availability table, one per row (e.g. PR - P1). Return the code as written.

name.name: Name
name.original: Unit type name from the 'Name' column, exactly as written.
name.description: Extract the unit type name from the 'Name' column of the Availability table, exactly as written.

avg_sq_ft.name: Avg. Sq Ft.
avg_sq_ft.original: Average square footage of the unit type, as a number.
avg_sq_ft.description: Extract the average square footage for this unit type as a number.

avg_rent.name: Avg. Rent
avg_rent.original: Average rent of the unit type as a number with no currency symbol.
avg_rent.description: Extract the average rent for this unit type as a number, without a currency symbol.

units.name: Units
units.original: Total number of units of this type. Whole number.
units.description: Extract the total number of units of this type. Return a whole number.

occ_no_notice.name: Occupied No Notice
occ_no_notice.original: Count of occupied units with no notice to vacate, from the 'Occupied No Notice' column.
occ_no_notice.description: Extract the count of occupied units with no notice to vacate from the 'Occupied No Notice' column. Return a whole number.

vacant_rented.name: Vacant Rented
vacant_rented.original: Count of vacant units that are already rented.
vacant_rented.description: Extract the count of vacant units that are already rented. Return a whole number.

vacant_unrented.name: Vacant Unrented
vacant_unrented.original: Count of vacant units that are not rented.
vacant_unrented.description: Extract the count of vacant units that are not rented. Return a whole number.

notice_rented.name: Notice Rented
notice_rented.original: Count of units on notice that are already rented.
notice_rented.description: Extract the count of units on notice that are already rented. Return a whole number.

notice_unrented.name: Notice Unrented
notice_unrented.original: Count of units on notice that are not rented.
notice_unrented.description: Extract the count of units on notice that are not rented. Return a whole number.

avail.name: Avail
avail.original: Value of the 'Avail' column. Take it from that column only, not from any similar-looking one.
avail.description: Extract the value from the 'Avail' column of the Availability table only; do not use a similar-looking column. Return a whole number.

model.name: Model
model.original: Number of model units from the 'Model' column. null if the table has no such column.
model.description: Extract the number of model units from the 'Model' column of the Availability table. Return a whole number. Return null if the table has no 'Model' column.

down.name: Down
down.original: Number of down units from the 'Down' column.
down.description: Extract the number of down units from the 'Down' column of the Availability table. Return a whole number.

admin.name: Admin
admin.original: Number of admin units from the 'Admin' column.
admin.description: Extract the number of admin units from the 'Admin' column of the Availability table. Return a whole number.

percent_occupied.name: % Occ
percent_occupied.original: Value of the '% Occ' column exactly as printed, e.g. 89.47.
percent_occupied.description: Extract the value of the '% Occ' column exactly as printed (e.g. 89.47).

p_occ_wornonrev.name: % Occ w/NonRev
p_occ_wornonrev.original: Value of the '% Occ w/NonRev' column exactly as printed. Do not confuse with '% Occ'.
p_occ_wornonrev.description: Extract the value of the '% Occ w/NonRev' column exactly as printed. Do not confuse it with '% Occ'.

percent_leased.name: % Leased
percent_leased.original: Value of the '% Leased' column exactly as printed.
percent_leased.description: Extract the value of the '% Leased' column exactly as printed.

p_trend.name: % Trend
p_trend.original: Value of the '% Trend' column exactly as printed.
p_trend.description: Extract the value of the '% Trend' column exactly as printed.
